mentions.name: Numen
mentions.description: A company research system that scrapes a company's website, profiles, press, and other findable online material, then runs it through a multi-model prompt engine built from scratch, chaining multiple LLMs with custom logic. The workflow has three stages — crawl, process, synthesize — and outputs markdown reports with no filler, aimed at GTM, growth, competitor analysis, product gaps, and strategic blindspots. Raw AI-generated analysis is refined with human strategic input before delivery. Sample reports (Grab, LemmyHomes) are published on GitHub; the backend is still in development and it is not yet sold as a product.
